label: iMessage Thread
description: A real iPhone Messages conversation, fitted to its box (use full-frame on 9x16, or inside a phone): blue (or green SMS) bubbles on the right, grey on the left, tails on the last bubble of each run, big standalone emoji, photos, link-preview cards, tapback reactions, typing dots before each reply, 'Delivered' under your latest, and the thread scrolls to keep the newest message above the bar. keyboard:true raises the keyboard and TYPES your messages key by key before sending them -- the 'customer texts you' / 'ask the agent' hook.

messages.label: Messages in order: { from: "me" | "them", text, emoji (big, no bubble), image (URL or true for a placeholder), link: { title, domain, image }, reaction (a tapback like "❤️" or "‼️"), reaction_at, at (seconds or "@word"; default in sequence) }

contact.label: { name, initials, photo (URL) } shown in the header

keyboard.label: Raise the keyboard and type your side key by key (default off)

timestamp.label: Day label above the thread (default "Today"); false hides it
